Title: Login succeeds with valid credentials
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Enter username; 3. Enter password; 4. Click the login button
Expected Result: User is redirected to /products and the Products heading is visible

Title: Login fails with wrong password
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Enter username; 3. Enter password; 4. Click the login button
Expected Result: Error message 'Invalid username or password.' is shown and the user stays on /login

Title: Locked user cannot log in
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Enter username; 3. Enter password; 4. Click the login button
Expected Result: Error message 'This user has been locked out.' is shown and the user stays on /login

Title: Login fails with empty username
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Leave username empty; 3. Enter password; 4. Click the login button
Expected Result: Error message 'Username is required.' is shown

Title: Login fails with empty password
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Enter username; 3. Leave password empty; 4. Click the login button
Expected Result: Error message 'Password is required.' is shown

Title: Slow user sees loading state then logs in
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login; 2. Enter username and password; 3. Click the login button; 4. Observe the button; 5. Wait for navigation
Expected Result: Button shows 'Signing in...' while waiting and the user is redirected to /products after about 3 seconds

Title: Protected page redirects to login when logged out
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /cart directly
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login

Title: Products load after the spinner
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps: 1. Open /products; 2. Wait for the loading spinner to disappear
Expected Result: Loading spinner disappears and 8 products are listed

Title: Search filters the product list
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /products
Steps: 1. Wait for products to load; 2. Type in the search box
Expected Result: Only 'Wireless Headphones' and 'Wireless Mouse' are listed

Title: Search with no match shows empty message
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /products
Steps: 1. Wait for products to load; 2. Type in the search box
Expected Result: Message 'No products found.' is shown and no products are listed

Title: Sort by price low to high
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /products
Steps: 1. Wait for products to load; 2. Select 'Price low-high' in the sort dropdown
Expected Result: First product is 'Notebook Set' ($12.99) and last product is 'Wireless Headphones' ($79.99)

Title: Sort by price high to low
Preconditions: User is logged in and on /products
Steps: 1. Wait for products to load; 2. Select 'Price high-low' in the sort dropdown
Expected Result: First product is 'Wireless Headphones' ($79.99) and last product is 'Notebook Set' ($12.99)

Title: Adding a product from the list updates the cart badge
Preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
Steps: 1. Open /products and wait for load; 2. Click 'Add to cart' on Ceramic Mug; 3. Click 'Add to cart' on Desk Lamp
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 2 and both buttons change to 'Remove'

Title: Add product with quantity 3 from the detail page
Preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
Steps: 1. Open /products/wireless-headphones; 2. Select quantity 3; 3. Click 'Add to cart'; 4. Open the cart
Expected Result: Message 'Added to cart.' is shown; the cart shows Wireless Headphones with quantity 3 and subtotal $239.97

Title: Empty cart shows message and disables checkout
Preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
Steps: 1. Open /cart
Expected Result: Message 'Your cart is empty.' is shown and the Checkout button is disabled

Title: Removing an item updates the cart total
Preconditions: User is logged in with Ceramic Mug and Desk Lamp in the cart
Steps: 1. Open /cart; 2. Click Remove on Ceramic Mug
Expected Result: Only Desk Lamp remains and the total is $39.99

Title: Checkout shows validation errors for empty form
Preconditions: User is logged in with Ceramic Mug in the cart
Steps: 1. Open /checkout; 2. Click 'Place order' without filling anything
Expected Result: Messages 'Full name is required.' 'Email is required.' 'Address is required.' and 'You must accept the terms.' are shown

Title: Checkout rejects an invalid email
Preconditions: User is logged in with Ceramic Mug in the cart
Steps: 1. Open /checkout; 2. Fill full name and address; 3. Enter an invalid email; 4. Tick the terms checkbox; 5. Click 'Place order'
Expected Result: Message 'Enter a valid email address.' is shown and no confirm modal opens

Title: Place an order with standard shipping
Preconditions: User is logged in with Ceramic Mug in the cart and no previous orders in this session
Steps: 1. Open /checkout; 2. Fill the form; 3. Keep Standard shipping; 4. Tick the terms checkbox; 5. Click 'Place order'; 6. Click Confirm in the modal; 7. Wait for the redirect
Expected Result: Button shows 'Placing order...' then the user lands on /order-success with 'Thank you for your order!' and order number ORD-0001; the order total is $14.99

Title: Express shipping adds 10 dollars to the total
Preconditions: User is logged in with Ceramic Mug in the cart
Steps: 1. Open /checkout; 2. Select Express shipping; 3. Read the order total
Expected Result: Order total is $24.99 (item price plus $10.00 express shipping)

Title: Reset app data clears state and logs out
Preconditions: User is logged in with an item in the cart
Steps: 1. Open /settings; 2. Click 'Reset app data'
Expected Result: Toast 'App data has been reset.' is shown; the user is logged out and the cart is empty after logging back in

Title: UI v2 login button is renamed
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login?ui=v2; 2. Enter username and password; 3. Click the sign-in button
Expected Result: Button is labelled 'Sign in' and the user is redirected to /products

Title: UI v2 add to basket from the product list
Preconditions: User is logged in with UI version v2 and an empty cart
Steps: 1. Open /products and wait for load (about 4 seconds); 2. Click 'Add to basket' on Ceramic Mug
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 1

Steps: 1. Type 'MUG' in search box; 2. Clear search box
Expected Result: 'Ceramic Mug' is displayed regardless of uppercase input, and clearing the box restores all 8 products.
